rows.label: Unsecured debt
rows.note: MANUAL EACH QUARTER - rule from history: every quarter for 14 years row 122 holds '=<Net Debt excluding Lease Obligations>+X127+X126-X117' (FY26: '=910485+T127+T126-T117'). The typed number is 7.2.1 'Net Debt excluding Lease Obligations' (also in Section 1 'Net Debt (excluding Lease obligations) Rs Mn'). For Jun-26 type '=818521+CA127+CA126-CA117' in CA122 = 1,258,768. Not mappable here: this mapping row binds to the label-only header row 121, and row 122 is a formula row, so the writer copies it forward - the 2026-10-04 run produced '=1124912+CA127+CA126-CA117' (Dec-25's number), overstating by 306,391. Do not set occurrence 2 while row 122 is a formula: compile_mapping skips formula rows before binding and raises a blocking mapping_row_unbound.
